description: Team for the students of Nagarjuna Vidyaniketan.
summary:
Our project, NASA 2030: Mission Director, is basically a 3D space exploration game where the player gets to act as a NASA mission director. The idea is to let players experience what goes into planning and carrying out a space mission instead of just learning about it theoretically. Players can choose missions, build their own rockets using different parts, prepare for launch and explore space.

We wanted to make learning about space more interesting and interactive because concepts like gravity, rocket propulsion and orbital mechanics can be quite difficult to understand just by reading about them. Through our game, players can actually see and experience some of these concepts in a 3D environment.

We developed a browser-based game using HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Three.js. It includes a 3D space environment with Earth, the Moon and Mars, along with rocket-building and space mission features.

Our main aim is to make space science easier to explore, more enjoyable to learn and interesting for people who are curious about space.
details:
Our project, **NASA_SPACE_APP_DIRECTOR**, is a 3D space mission simulation game set in the year 2030. The player takes the role of a NASA Mission Director and is responsible for planning and managing space missions to the Moon or Mars.

Players can build their own rockets, choose equipment such as cameras, power systems and communication devices, and manage a mission budget of **$175 million**. During the mission, they must handle challenges like power usage, communication delays and space hazards while trying to complete their scientific objectives.

We are developing the game using HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Three.js. Our aim is to make learning about space exploration more interactive while helping players understand rocket engineering, teamwork, budgeting and decision-making.

**Live Game:** https://lakshcodemaxxer.github.io/NASA-SPACE-APP-DIRECTOR/

**GitHub Repository:** https://github.com/lakshcodemaxxer/NASA-SPACE-APP-DIRECTOR
